Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

The IT team supports SambaNova’s employees and infrastructure. We manage the servers, networks, and cloud accounts our engineering teams use to build and test AI chips and systems. **About Runware**
-----------------

Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and operates its own infrastructure, end to end. One API gives developers access to image, video, audio, 3D and language models, and our Sonic Inference Engine runs them on hardware we designed ourselves: custom servers, custom boards and a closed-loop, water-free cooling system, packed into Sonic Inference Pods — roughly 1 MW of liquid-cooled GPU compute in a 20-foot container that can be sited wherever power is cheap and available.

This is why infrastructure at Runware is the product, not a cost center. Our edge is that we run inference 30–90% cheaper per GPU-hour than our peers, and that edge is earned in the data center: in how fast we can stand up a new site, how tightly we run our fleet, and how little downtime our customers ever see. More than 20 billion requests have run through the platform for over a million developers, with customers such as Wix, Quora, Freepik and Higgsfield building production applications on top of it.

We raised a $50M Series A led by Dawn Capital, with Comcast Ventures, Speedinvest, Insight Partners and a16z speedrun participating, and we are now building out a global network of pods across the US and Europe. We need someone to own how that network is operated.

------------

As Head of Infrastructure Operations, you'll own the physical and operational backbone of Runware: the servers, storage and networking across every site we run, and the team that keeps them running. You'll take us from a handful of pods to a global fleet, and you'll decide how that fleet is built, provisioned, monitored, maintained and scaled.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set the operating model and hire the team, but you'll also be in the terminal, in the rack and in the incident channel when it matters. colliga is building deterministic governance for probabilistic AI systems (large language models to start). It checks what a probabilistic model produces against the rules an enterprise has set, determines admissibility, and keeps a versioned, replayable record of every decision. It works mid-stream, and only returns responses that are fully compliant, thus replacing traditional guardrails.

**The problem**

Businesses deploying AI are discovering that a model usually behaves as trained with current governance techniques, but not always. "Usually" is not good enough for high-stakes use-cases, and therefore not something a regulator, auditor or buyer's legal or security teams will sign off on. As a result, AI is failing to reach its full potential for critical tasks. A governed, logged, deterministic gate can turn "usually" into "always, provably, and with evidence" for many of these systems.

ClickHouse started as an open-source project that developers picked up on their own, told each other about, and built companies on. That community is still the reason most people first hear of us, and it is why ClickHouse Cloud fills with new users every day. As the database becomes a platform for real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads, the community has more to learn from us and more to teach us than ever. Developer relations is how we hold up our end of that relationship.

As Head of Developer Relations, you’ll own how developers discover ClickHouse, get productive on it, and bring others along: the developer experience, the technical content that teaches it, the channels where developers find it, and the community that carries it. You’ll lead our global team of developer advocates and give the function the goals, systems, and investment of a core growth channel. You’ll partner closely with product marketing engineers, field marketing in every region, and product and engineering, and you’ll inherit a strong, globally distributed team and a community that has been generous with us for years. If you believe developer relations starts with helping people, that trust is the only thing that compounds, and that the work should be measured like any other growth investment, this is a rare seat.

Nearly every company in the world runs on custom software for critical operations like tracking performance metrics, handling support workflows, building admin dashboards, and countless processes you might never have thought of. Job Description
The Director, Third-Party Cyber Defense is Allstate’s senior leader for supplier cyber incident response. The role is accountable for how quickly and appropriately Allstate understands and responds when a supplier is compromised. A supplier just told us they’ve been breached.

Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As AI designs more of biology, the bottleneck moves to experiments: running them fast, at scale and with data people can trust. Adaptyv is the company best positioned to become the verification layer for biology, and long-term partnerships with pharma, biotech and frontier AI labs are how we get there.

You find the partners where Adaptyv can become core infrastructure. You shape the terms, and you run the deal: scientific scope, pricing, legal, and the internal plan to deliver it. You also design new partnership models and the deals that do not fit a standard quote.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead the largest deals. Source, structure and close strategic partnerships with pharma, biotech and frontier AI labs.

 - Set the terms. Pricing, data rights, exclusivity, milestones. You find structures where both sides win.

 - Align the company behind each deal. The lab, the scientists and engineering deliver what you sign, so you bring them in early.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Deal-maker with a track record. You have closed complex, high-value deals in life sciences, AI or deep tech. Biopharma BD, corporate development or partnerships experience is ideal. We will also bet on rising talent.

 - Credible with scientists. You can follow a discussion about binding data and assay design, and you know when to bring in the expert.

 - High agency. Nobody hands you a pipeline. You build it, and you own the outcome.

 - AI-native. It's 2026: you use Claude and similar tools every day for research, modeling and drafting, and you check what they produce.

 - Low ego, high EQ. Partners trust you, and so does the team.



Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

As AI accelerates software development, the need for reliable verification is only increasing. Antithesis exists to solve that problem.



We are well-funded, deeply technical, and building a category-defining platform for modern software reliability.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The duty of this organization is to enable our Customers' ongoing Mission Readiness. From the moment they say "go" until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.

Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not "core" to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.

As Anduril's installed base grows across an increasing number of products and Business Lines, our MRO organization needs to move from a collection of program-specific repair processes and tools to a hardened, scalable operating model. This role is about leading that shift.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Director of MRO Transformation to lead the modernization and scaling of Anduril's repair operations. Where our Head of MRO oversees the collective repair function, this Director role owns the transformation agenda: establishing core processes for any Business Line to leverage, selecting and implementing the tools and systems MRO runs on, and driving the change management needed to get a fast-growing collection of programs onto common, scalable rails. You will assess where today's pockets of good activity exist, build the roadmap to modernize them, and lead cross-functional teams through the change without slowing down repair turnaround for products already in the field. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

Job Overview
We are hiring an IT Business Relationship Director to ensure IT service delivery meets the operational needs of program offices across the Americas geography (US and LATAM), translating business needs into IT priorities and IT technical capability into business value. The role sits at the intersection of IT and program operations — building trust with leadership, diagnosing where IT processes break down, and brokering the cross-office knowledge and escalation paths that don't currently exist structurally.

This role will operate as the connective layer between IT and Resettlement, Asylum and Integration (RAI) and Crisis, Response, Recovery and Development (CRRD) leadership across the US and LATAM, working alongside the Global IT Solutions team, the Americas IT Service Desk (POD) and RAI Operations staff. They will build a regular engagement cadence with RAI office and CRRD program leadership, develop enough programmatic fluency to judge whether an IT solution will work in the field, own escalations, knowing when an issue needs IT leadership, a vendor, or executive attention. The role embeds proactive communication and cross-office knowledge-sharing into how IT and program operations work together, so that consistency across offices is structural rather than dependent on individual relationships.

About Amazon Web Services

Amazon Web Services (AWS) offers a broad set of global compute, storage, database, analytics, application, and deployment services that help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale applications. These services are trusted by the largest enterprises and the hottest start-ups to power a wide variety of workloads — including web and mobile applications, data processing and warehousing, storage, archive, and many others.

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

The Opportunity

For a decade, WorkSpaces has been exceptional at what it was designed to do: securely deliver a virtual desktop where a user logs in, applications load, work happens, the session ends. It is reactive by design—with no memory of what occurred, no understanding of intent, and no ability to act on the user's behalf. But work has changed. The modern enterprise now runs on three workforces: humans who set direction, AI agents that execute delegated work, and the systems that run the business. Non-human identities already outnumber human ones, yet no infrastructure layer governs all three within a single trust boundary. Whoever solves this—making the secure, governed path the fastest path—will define how the world works for the next decade.

Amazon WorkSpaces is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. We are extending its trust boundary from humans to humans and AI agents working together, governed by default. This is not an incremental improvement but a reimagining of the workspace itself—from a platform that delivers applications and compute into one that actively partners with users: understanding intent, orchestrating workflows across systems, anticipating needs, and reducing friction at every step.

We are looking for a seasoned product leader to own the end-to-end product strategy for Amazon WorkSpaces and define the future of work at the intersection of human talent and agentic AI. You will treat the workspace not as a container for compute but as the orchestration layer where humans and AI collaborate—reimagining every surface through the lens of human-AI partnership, and making AI adoption effortless for enterprises that have rightly prioritized security, governance, and compliance above all else.

Key job responsibilities

roles.description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real.

The Estate Lawyers is a growing estate planning and administration firm built on a simple belief: families deserve clear guidance and exceptional service during some of the most important moments of their lives. We take that seriously — in how we practice law, how we treat each other, and how we build our firm.

We operate on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System), which means we run on clear priorities, honest conversations, and measurable results. Our core values aren't wall décor — they show up in how we make decisions, how we hold each other accountable, and who we hire.

We're at an inflection point. The firm is growing — in clients, in people, and in locations — and we need the operational foundation to match. That's why this role exists.

This is a builder role for a firm that is ready to scale.

As Director of Operations & Technology, you own the roadmap for how this firm grows — operationally, technologically, and structurally. You identify what's holding us back before it becomes a problem, design the fix, and see it through to measurable results.

You sit on the Leadership Team and report directly to the CEO/Integrator. You're not here to coordinate for other leaders — you're here to raise the standard of how the whole firm operates, and you have the authority to do it.

You're drawn to complexity, not intimidated by it. You see operational gaps as problems worth solving, not someone else's mess to manage.

You set a high bar — for yourself and for the work around you. You don't need consensus to move, but you know how to bring people with you. You communicate directly and earn trust through follow-through, not charm.

About Amazon Web Services
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) offers a broad set of global compute, storage, database, analytics, application, and deployment services that help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale applications. These services are trusted by the largest enterprises and the hottest start-ups to power a wide variety of workloads — including web and mobile applications, data processing and warehousing, storage, archive, and many others.
  
  
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
For a decade, WorkSpaces has been exceptional at what it was designed to do: securely deliver a virtual desktop where a user logs in, applications load, work happens, the session ends. It is reactive by design—with no memory of what occurred, no understanding of intent, and no ability to act on the user's behalf. But work has changed. The modern enterprise now runs on three workforces: humans who set direction, AI agents that execute delegated work, and the systems that run the business. Non-human identities already outnumber human ones, yet no infrastructure layer governs all three within a single trust boundary. Whoever solves this—making the secure, governed path the fastest path—will define how the world works for the next decade.
  
  
Amazon WorkSpaces is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. We are extending its trust boundary from humans to humans and AI agents working together, governed by default. This is not an incremental improvement but a reimagining of the workspace itself—from a platform that delivers applications and compute into one that actively partners with users: understanding intent, orchestrating workflows across systems, anticipating needs, and reducing friction at every step.
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned product leader to own the end-to-end product strategy for Amazon WorkSpaces and define the future of work at the intersection of human talent and agentic AI. You will treat the workspace not as a container for compute but as the orchestration layer where humans and AI collaborate—reimagining every surface through the lens of human-AI partnership, and making AI adoption effortless for enterprises that have rightly prioritized security, governance, and compliance above all else.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Product Vision & Strategy - Human-AI Collaboration

The Vice President of Reliability, And Process Optimization is an executive leadership role responsible for directing enterprise-wide strategies that maximize asset uptime, operational efficiency, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE). This role bridges executive strategy and site-level execution, driving a proactive culture of engineering reliability, continuous process optimization, and total asset lifecycle management. Working closely with Senior Operations Leaders, the VP will oversee cross-functional programs across multi-site industrial and manufacturing operations, integrating digital technologies to transform traditional operations into modern, data-driven, and highly resilient operational environments.

- Transition multi-site operations from reactive/breakdown maintenance to proactive, predictive (PdM), and condition-based monitoring strategies.
- Establish standardized Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and Bad Actor elimination programs across all facilities.
- Standardize work planning, scheduling, spare parts inventory control (MRO management), and contractor execution frameworks.

- Establish and mandate enterprise-wide standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational governance frameworks while preserving necessary regional adaptability.
- Drive organizational change initiatives, fostering operator ownership (Autonomous Maintenance) and cross-level operational discipline.

- Build enterprise dashboards and real-time analytics for tracking asset performance, failure rates, cost variance, and operational efficiency metrics.
- Collaborate with IT/OT leadership to ensure seamless integration across enterprise platforms (ERP, CMMS, SCADA, MES).
- Build, mentor, and direct a high-performing centralized team of Reliability Engineers, Operational Excellence specialists, and Asset Managers.
- Help establish and manage annual OpEx and CapEx budgets for reliability and operational transformation programs; deliver measurable ROI through cost reduction and capacity release.
- Ensure all reliability, maintenance, and asset management programs strictly adhere to Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) requirements and regulatory standards.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril’s Manufacturing Engineering Team is seeking a Director, Industrial Engineering to lead IE strategy and execution for the Air Defense & Strike (AD&S) division. Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

コレクターズ（Collectors）は、世界中のコレクターの皆様に付加価値の高いサービスを提供する、革新的なテクノロジーのリーディングカンパニーです。私たちは、数百万点に及ぶ記録的な価値を持つコレクターズアイテムのグレーディング、真贋鑑定、保管、および販売を行っています。また、コレクターの皆様が自身の情熱を追求できるよう支援するというというミッションのもと、これらのプロセスの近代化とデジタル化にも注力しています。現在、成長を続ける私たちのチームに加わっていただける人材を常に募集しています。

当社のサービス対象は、トレーディングカード、サイン、コミック、コイン、ビデオゲーム、イベントチケット、メモラビリアなど多岐にわたります。主な傘下ブランドには、PSA、PCGS、Beckett、SGC、Card Ladderが含まれます。

1986年の創業以来、私たちは数百万点ものアイテムのグレーディング、と真贋鑑定を行ってきました。カリフォルニア州サンタアナの本社に加え、ニュージャージー、テキサス、フロリダ、日本、上海、香港、カナダ、メキシコ、ドイツ、フランスに拠点を構え、合計3,000名以上の従業員が活躍しています。

当社の面接プロセスの一環として、ビデオ面接の際はカメラをオンにしていただくようお願いしております。これにより、より充実した対話を促し、実際の職場環境に近い環境を再現するためです。なお、選考の段階によっては電話で実施する場合もございます。また、リモートワークの職種においても、弊社の判断により、選考の最終段階としてオンサイトでの面接をお願いする場合がございます。

状況によりは特別な配慮が必要となる場合があることも承知しておりますので、必要に応じて個別にご相談にのって承ります。詳細なプロセスやご期待に沿えるか等の確認につきましては、採用担当者からご説明いたしますので、ご不明な点がございましたらお気軽にご質問ください。

UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.  
  
Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.  
  
UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for a Director of Mission Operations to build and lead the team that delivers UFORCE's uncrewed systems missions. You'll own the operational portfolio across the customer lifecycle: pre-sale demonstrations, events and exercises, as well as post-sale deployments and customer implementations.

Reporting to the VP of Delivery, you'll lead and develop our Mission Managers, establish the standards and decision-making practices for safe, repeatable execution, and make sure concurrent missions have the people, equipment and support they need. You'll work closely with the Director of Training, who provides training personnel, pilots and field deployment engineers, and the Director of Operations, who supplies equipment, products and logistics.

This is a hands-on leadership role, but not one where you'll personally run every mission. You'll deploy when it matters—on first-of-kind, high-risk or high-visibility missions, or to coach and assess your team—while building an operation that succeeds through capable mission leaders.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the mission portfolio across demonstrations, exercises, deployments and customer implementations. Maintain a clear view of upcoming work, mission ownership, staffing, assets, readiness and risk.
* Review new opportunities for operational feasibility, capacity and risk before commitments are made. Resolve competing demands where you can, and bring recommended trade-offs to leadership when needed.
* Lead, hire and develop Mission Managers. Establish clear expectations, a structured qualification path, regular feedback and backup coverage, while managing deployment tempo and fatigue.
* Set and maintain practical mission standards, including planning templates, risk assessments, readiness reviews, briefs, communications plans and closeout reports. Check that they work in the field and improve them as the team learns.
* Establish clear decision and escalation boundaries with leadership and the appropriate technical and safety owners. Make it safe and expected for the team to raise concerns and pause or stop a mission.
* Work with the Director of Training to secure qualified personnel and with the Director of Operations to secure platforms, equipment, logistics and support. Set clear requirements and lead assigned personnel during mission execution

As Consumer Engineering Leader, you’ll be the engineering counterpart to our Consumer Product Leader. Together you’ll own a simple question: How can we extend our product suite to be integrated deeper with our customers’ financial lives?

Engineering leadership at Taptap Send is hands on. You’ll be building POCs while managing/coaching a team of super passionate, high caliber engineers. We are looking for someone who finds themselves on the cusp of product and engineering and is excited to shape the next generation of products at a company with millions of customers.
